descriptorExport.liveMark: buildMarkerEvent(request {kind, occurredAt, flight?, label?, note?}, {acquisition:'manual', context, observedAt, origin}) in marker.ts -> Effect<DxEventEnvelope, InvalidInput>; for the dx_mark capability handler (A02/A07 appends it via EventStore and returns {eventId, flightId: event.context.flightId})
descriptorExport.intervals: pairMarkerIntervals(events) in intervals.ts -> per flight {active, waiting: Interval[], claims, anomalies}
descriptorExport.logLine: toMarkerLogLine(request, branch) serializes a dx.manual.marker.v1 JSONL line

sourceProbe: No external source: markers are produced by the recorder itself (dx_mark) or by a dx.manual.marker.v1 JSONL log. Fixtures are hand-written, origin=fixture.

checks.cmd: pnpm --filter @rat-stack/core exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json (filtered to manual/ and b22)

events.marker.start|stop|wait-start|wait-stop|c: acquisition manual (live) or file-import; payload {markerKind, flightId, label|null, note|null, claim, method:'user-claimed'}; occurredAt method observed (live recorder clock) or user-claimed (imported log); label/note fieldSemantics user-claimed; context.flightId always set

rules: flightId: explicit flight > context.flightId > branch:<sha12(repoCommonDir)>:<branch> (or branch:<branch>) > InvalidInput
claim requires a non-empty label; label <=120, note <=500, flight <=200 chars; control chars stripped; otherwise InvalidInput
eventId deterministic: sha256(manual, upstreamKey, kind), upstreamKey = flight:kind:iso:contentHash16; re-import dedupes
Pairing per flight in time order; unmatched close -> startMs null, unclosed/reopened open -> endMs null (censored, never assumed now) with an anomaly gap
gaps: dx_mark capability handler/CLI wiring and registry registration belong to integration (A02/A07/A08); B22 only provides buildMarkerEvent and the descriptor.
Markers and claims are user-claimed; metrics must keep them separate from observed activity and must not treat them as AI ownership or savings.
Waiting time exists only between explicit wait markers; nothing infers waiting from idle gaps.
Imported logs: bad lines become coverage gaps (line-unparseable / line-invalid), coverage partial.
